title: Button
description: The action control, 1.0 variants: subtle (default) for ordinary actions, surface for toolbar actions, inverse for the main action of a card or a list title row, outline beside an inverse one, ghost for icon buttons, primary / secondary (the brand fills) only for the one main button of a page, a dialog or the nav, danger (solid red) for destructive actions, danger-subtle (the danger tint) for a destructive action that is not the main one. Spinner shows work in progress inside the control that runs it.
when: Any action: save, create, refresh, delete, open a dialog.
Icon-only toolbar actions (iconOnly + aria-label); an attention count on one with badge.
Dialog footers (size="modal": 44px touch target on phones): commit primary, cancel subtle, a destructive confirm danger.
The one call to action of a page header: size="lg" (40px; lint one-large-button warns on a second one in the same header). A small pill CTA: size="pill" (24px, fully rounded).
Round icon buttons over media, in an overlay header or beside a carousel (iconOnly + shape="round"); the inverse pill of a list title row (size="xs" shape="round").

instead.use: next/link (styled with BTN_* from @semi/ui/styles when it must look like a button)

a11y: Renders a real <button type="button"> (pass type="submit" in forms).
iconOnly requires aria-label (the types enforce it); keep a title for the tooltip. With badge, say the count in the aria-label ("Thông báo, 3 chưa đọc").
loading sets aria-busy and blocks clicks. Keyboard focus is a 2px outline in the strong text colour on every variant; disabled is neutral for every variant.
A 24px hit area at every size that grows to 44px on a touch screen (any-pointer-coarse), without a bigger drawn button.

examples.title: Variants
examples.description: subtle (default) for ordinary actions, surface for toolbar actions, inverse for a card's or a list title row's main action, outline beside it, ghost for quiet and icon actions, primary / secondary (brand) for the one main button of the page or dialog, danger (solid red, white text) for destructive, danger-subtle (tint, line, danger text) for a quieter destructive action. The second row is disabled: neutral for every variant.

examples.title: Icon and icon-only
examples.description: icon adds a leading icon; iconOnly needs an aria-label.

examples.title: Round
examples.description: shape="round" makes an icon-only button a circle (media tiles, overlay headers, carousel arrows) and a labelled one a pill; the fill, focus and size stay the variant's.

examples.title: Loading
examples.description: loading swaps the icon for a spinner and blocks clicks.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: lg (40px, 14px) for the one call to action of a page header, md (default, 34px, 14px text) for content, sm (28px, 12px text) for dense rows and toolbars, pill (24px, 12px, fully rounded) for a small pill CTA, xs (24px) for the inverse pill of a list title row, modal for dialog footers and a full-width commit; every size is at least 44px on a touch phone. The second row: danger at lg and md, danger-subtle as a pill. badge pins an attention count to an icon button.

examples.title: Hover and press
examples.description: One hover timing (transition-hover, 150ms) and one press for every control: buttons, icon buttons, chips, toggles, checkboxes and switches shrink to 98% while pressed (PRESS; still under reduced motion). Rows, list items, cards and an app's own tiles (PRESSABLE) never shrink: they keep their hover fill while pressed. Hover shows on any device with a pointer that can hover (any-hover), an iPad with a trackpad too.
